description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Luxury Home in Highland Parks* Golf cart available to rent during your stay with golf cart vendor Quik Ryde: 850-517-4768* 4 Bikes Included* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Blue Mountain Beach Access 0.9 miles (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Wheelchair Accessible, Ed Walline Public Beach access, is 1.6 miles* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center!* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Sandy Cheeks is a gorgeous 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home in the Highland Parks community of Blue Mountain Beach, just off Hwy 30A. Enjoy cooking family meals together in the stunning gourmet kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. There are two master bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms and king beds, the second floor master bedroom features double vanity sinks and a large walk in shower. On the second floor, you will also find a guest bedroom with two queen beds, and a guest bedroom with twin bunkbeds and a queen bed, allowing this spacious home to comfortably sleep 12 guests. Less than a mile to the beach, this home includes amazing neighborhood amenities such as a free form tropically landscaped lagoon pool with whirlpool, community grilling area, and fire pit with comfy chairs and couches - sit, chat and enjoy your favorite drink with your family and friends! A 360-observation tower allows you to see the gulf, the bay, and miles along the coast to Seaside and Sandestin in either direction. Treat yourself to the vacation of your dreams at Sandy Cheeks!Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Park is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor2nd Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Queen BedsGuest Bedroom: Twin bunkbed and Queen Bed (Jack and Jill bathrooms adjoin the guest bedrooms)*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates* Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!"*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*Area Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation devices when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
